# SKYRA

SKYRA shows live weather for Malaysia and cities worldwide: temperature, hourly and 7-day outlook, rain, wind, UV, air quality, and short forecast-based alerts.

## Project

- Name: SURESH KALEYANNAN
- Maintainer: SURESH KALEYANNAN (https://github.com/sureshapps)
- Source: https://github.com/sureshapps/Skyra
- License: MPL-2.0 (https://www.mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/)
- Built with: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript

## What it does

Open the site, search a city or allow GPS, and read the forecast in your language. Saved places stay on the device (up to 8). Alerts come from forecast fields; they are not official IMD bulletins.

## Features

- Hourly and 7-day temperature
- Rain, wind, humidity, pressure, visibility
- UV index and air quality
- Worldwide city search (Open-Meteo geocoding)
- GPS reverse geocode (BigDataCloud)
- Device language default, with 70+ UI languages
- Saved places in local storage

## Data

- Forecast: Open-Meteo (https://open-meteo.com), CC BY 4.0
- Geocoding: Open-Meteo Geocoding API
- Reverse geocode: BigDataCloud Client API
- UI translation: MyMemory (cached on the server)

## FAQ

Q: What is SKYRA?
A: A free open-source weather site for Malaysia and global cities, with hourly and 7-day forecasts plus air quality.

Q: Who maintains it?
A: Suresh Kaleyannan. The source is on GitHub under MPL-2.0.

Q: Which languages work?
A: English and 70+ others. Default follows the phone or browser when possible.

Q: Are alerts official government warnings?
A: No. They are tips from forecast data, not IMD official bulletins.
